metadata.short_desc: Multi-backend RAG long-term memory with an admin view
metadata.desc: AstrBot long-term memory storage and retrieval plugin for multiple vector databases.

LLM_providers.hint: LLM Provider used for memory summaries. Leave empty to resolve the default provider for each session independently.

summary_fallback_provider_id.hint: Retry once when the primary provider fails or returns empty content. Leave empty to disable the fallback.

summary_max_concurrency.hint: Limits concurrent summary jobs so simultaneous sessions do not amplify LLM and Embedding load.

summary_request_timeout_seconds.hint: Cancels a summary LLM request after this interval and tries the fallback provider.

embedding_provider_id.hint: Embedding Provider used to generate vectors. Leave empty to use the first configured AstrBot Embedding Provider.

embedding_request_timeout_seconds.hint: Cancels an Embedding request after this interval so chat and background jobs are not blocked.

vector_db_type.hint: Select a vector backend. Chroma runs locally without extra services; Milvus targets large deployments; Qdrant provides high-performance retrieval; Weaviate supports embedded and server modes.
subtitles: Local persistence with no extra service

milvus_lite_path.hint: Milvus Lite database file path. Set either this option or address; this option takes precedence.

db_name.hint: Milvus 2.2 and later supports multiple databases. The default is default; use another name to isolate data.

authentication.hint: Fill these fields when Milvus server authentication is enabled.

token.hint: A token takes precedence over username and password.

chroma_config.hint: Only used when vector_db_type is chroma.

persist_directory.hint: Leave empty to use chroma_data under the plugin data directory.

host.hint: Set this for client mode. Leave empty for local persistence.

qdrant_config.hint: Only used when vector_db_type is qdrant.

path.hint: Leave empty to use qdrant_data under the plugin data directory.

url.hint: For example http://localhost:6333. Leave empty for local persistence.

api_key.hint: Optional API key for client mode.

weaviate_config.hint: Only used when vector_db_type is weaviate.

embedded.hint: Run Weaviate inside the local process without an external service.

persistence_data_path.hint: Leave empty to use weaviate_data under the plugin data directory.

url.hint: Used in client mode, for example http://localhost:8080.

api_key.hint: Optional API key for client mode.

summary_check_task.hint: Experimental: adds a summary after a long period without conversation.

SUMMARY_TIME_THRESHOLD_SECONDS.hint: Defaults to 3600 seconds. Set to -1 to disable.

collection_name.hint: Collection that stores long-term memories. Use an English name.

use_personality_filtering.hint: Filters retrieval by persona ID so different personas do not share memories.

use_session_filtering.hint: Keeps memories isolated by session. Disable to share one memory pool across all sessions.

platform_blacklist.hint: Platform IDs in this list skip long-term memory retrieval and writes.

use_participant_filtering.hint: Prefer memories related to the current speaker to reduce cross-talk in group chats.

personality_fallback.hint: Use AstrBot's default persona when the conversation has no persona configured.

num_pairs.hint: One user-assistant exchange counts as one round. Summarization runs when this count is reached.

context_cache_max_sessions.hint: Evicts the least recently active sessions after this limit.

context_cache_idle_ttl_seconds.hint: Sessions idle longer than this are released. Set to 0 to disable time-based eviction.

context_cache_max_messages.hint: Keeps only recent messages after this limit. It should be at least twice num_pairs.

top_k.hint: Number of relevant memories retrieved and injected per conversation.

contexts_memory_len.hint: Values below 0 keep all blocks; values at or above 0 keep only the latest N blocks.

memory_injection_method.hint: extra_user_parts appends memory as a temporary content block on the current user message without writing history; user_prompt edits the user prompt; system_prompt edits the system prompt; insert_system_prompt adds a separate system message and may reduce prompt-cache hits.
subtitles: Append a temporary TextPart to the current message

memory_injection_interval.hint: Retrieve and inject memory once every N conversation rounds. 1 means every round.

memory_injection_position.hint: Controls placement for user_prompt, system_prompt, and insert_system_prompt. extra_user_parts is always appended after the current user message.

max_prompt_chars_for_embedding.hint: Long input is truncated before embedding to avoid oversized requests or context limits.

enable_explicit_memory_capture.hint: Writes long-term memory when a user message starts with remember or an equivalent explicit request.

enable_llm_memory_tool.hint: Allows tool-capable models to write current-session memories when the user asks or when stable preferences, personal facts, or important plans appear.

use_lightweight_memory_graph.hint: Expands one-hop entity relationships into keywords to improve multi-hop memory retrieval.

use_summary_time_anchor.description: Add absolute time anchors to summaries
use_summary_time_anchor.hint: Reduces fabricated years and dates in summary text.

include_tool_context_in_summary.hint: Includes tool names, arguments, and results in summaries. When disabled, only user and assistant conversation text is summarized.

summary_speaker_mapping_prompt.hint: Constrains ownership of user, assistant, and first-person references. Supports {persona_id}, {session_id}, {sender_id}, and {sender_name}. Leave empty to disable.

long_memory_prompt.hint: Defines the long-term memory format, key facts, and speaker constraints.
